name: Structure A: 2026 Traditional Pattern (Aon CoCubes)
description: Standard Capgemini Exceller recruitment pattern with strict sectional elimination. Focuses on Pseudocode dry-running, Core CS MCQs, Cognitive mini-games, and Coding.

sections.title: Technical MCQs (Core CS)
sections.description: OOPs, DBMS, SQL, OS, Networks, Cloud fundamentals

sections.title: Pseudocode Output Tracing
sections.description: Bitwise logic, recursion stacks, loop bounds, arrays

sections.title: English Communication Test
sections.description: Grammar, sentence correction, vocabulary, reading comprehension

sections.title: Game-Based Cognitive Assessment
sections.description: Deductive Geo-Sudo, Inductive Spacio, Grid, Motion, Switch, Digit

sections.title: Behavioral Assessment (PowerSkills)
sections.description: Situational Judgment Tests aligned with Capgemini 7 Core Values

sections.title: Hands-on Coding Round
sections.description: Medium DSA (Arrays, Strings, Hashing, Two Pointers)

name: Structure B: 2027 Candidate-Reported Pattern
description: Emerging AI-augmented recruitment pattern reported by recent cohorts. Features live AI-assisted development, debugging, prompt engineering, and communication.

sections.title: Professional Communication
sections.description: Verbal reasoning, technical email composition, and comprehension

sections.title: Problem Solving & Debugging
sections.description: Identify logic flaws, boundary errors, and syntax bugs in C++/Java/Python

sections.title: AI-Assisted Debugging
sections.description: Diagnose full-stack React/Node/Java concurrency bugs using AI prompts

sections.title: AI-Assisted Feature Development
sections.description: Build real features (search filters, pagination, API caching) with AI review

sections.title: Prompt Engineering & AI Literacy
sections.description: RAG, prompt optimization, token context, hallucination mitigation, security

name: Custom Modular Simulation
description: Candidate-configurable practice mode where individual sections, question volumes, and time limits can be customized.
